{{Short description|German physicist}}
'''Stephan Herminghaus''' is a German physicist. He received a PhD in Physics from the [[University of Mainz]] in 1989. His postdoctoral stay was at the IBM Research Center in San Jose, California (USA), in 1990 . He completed his [[habilitation]] at the [[University of Konstanz]] in 1994 and was the head of an independent research group at the MPI for Colloids and Interfaces, Berlin, from 1996 until 1999. He then became a full professor at the University of Ulm from 1999 until 2003. Since 2003, he has been a director at the [[Max Planck Institute for Dynamics and Self-Organization|Max Planck Institute for Dynamics and Self-Organization (MPI-DS)]], [[Göttingen]].<ref>{{cite news |title=Scientists discover why sandcastles are really child's play |url=http://www.hindu.com/thehindu/holnus/008200802111450.htm |work=[[The Hindu]] |date=11 February 2008 |accessdate=14 February 2011 }}</ref> Since 2005, he has an additional appointment as an adjunct professor at the [[University of Göttingen]]. Further, he was appointed as Professeur Invité at Université Paris VI for the winter term 2006/07. As a director of the MPI-DS, Stephan Herminghaus retired in 2023.
